capabilities: Draw progress clocks from plain-text lines
Tick and clear segments by click or keyboard
Race two clocks side by side
Track counters and stopwatches in the same block
Fire workspace events for other plugins
disambiguation: Not a clock, timer or time-tracking plugin; the clocks are segmented progress trackers for tabletop games.
extras: Free and MIT licensed, with a browser demo of the plugin. Shows one static ad inside its clocks block (the Players button) promoting the maker's paid DM Screen app; it can be turned off in settings. Clocks are limited to 2-12 segments.
problem: Progress clocks and resource counters in tabletop notes are plain text, so ticking them means retyping numbers by hand.

relations.evidence: Session Log listens for clock changes, so with both installed every tick lands in your session note's log
With DM Screen installed, the Players button under the clocks starts sharing, with the open note's clocks on their phones.

summary: Renders segmented progress clocks, counters and stopwatches from plain-text lines in a note, ticking them on click and writing the count back.
